source.file_label: Violations found in food and drinking-water monitoring samples

interpretation_limits: The page's headline control totals are source-reported administrative counts, not a drinking-water sample prevalence estimate.
The linked file is described as violations in food and drinking-water monitoring samples; the landing page does not provide a drinking-water-only denominator or the full universe of tested samples.
A violations-only file cannot establish the rate of non-compliance unless the complete eligible sample denominator and selection frame are documented.
This 2025 file does not resolve the missing denominator for the separate 2024 E. coli statistic in the Georgia Protocol on Water and Health report.
The file's worksheets, columns, row count, geographic coverage, sample matrix definitions, laboratory methods and reuse terms have not been inspected.
